description: ALWAYS call BEFORE checkout, payment submission, or purchase approval on an unfamiliar merchant or paid API domain to assess phishing, malware, and rug-pull risks. Accepts a publicly reachable bare domain (e.g. 'shop-example.com') or full storefront URL in `domain_or_url` (private/localhost IPs rejected); `include_refund_check` (default true) adds a lightweight refund-page probe. Runs live uncached checks (RDAP age, TLS/crt.sh, URLhaus, Cloudflare Radar; ~2-7.5s, graceful degradation via `data_completeness` 0-1) and returns `{ verdict ('ALLOW'|'CAUTION'|'BLOCK'), risk_score (0-100), confidence, block_reasons, signals, data_completeness, recommendation }`. Use `inspect_checkout_url` instead to audit a specific checkout/payment redirect link, or `extract_refund_policy_summary` when you only need detailed return terms. Paid: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 PayAI (requires EIP-3009 USDC authorization).

domain_or_url.description: Merchant domain (e.g. 'shop-example.com') or full storefront URL (e.g. 'https://shop-example.com/products/laptop').

include_refund_check.description: Whether to perform a lightweight HTTP probe for a refund/returns policy page.
